title: BTP01-50 Universal Battery Temp Plate – Plate: Temp, Battery, 120v, 15a
description: The BTP01-50 is designed to monitor temperature of batteries placed on it. Automatically shuts down the charger in the event the temperature exceeds 50 degrees Celsius. Audible and visual alarms combined with auto power off enable user to reduce monitoring while charging batteries. Auto shut off Manual reset 120 V 15 amp AC Audio & visual alarms Plate dimensions 10” X 10” X 3/8”
